title: write-commit-message returns an empty message
body:
### What happened

Running write-commit-message with staged changes printed an empty commit message.

### What you expected

A commit message.

### Version or environment

Linux

title: Empty commit message from write-commit-message for staged files
body:
### What happened

I staged files and ran /64x-lunicorn:write-commit-message; the message was empty.

### What you expected

A Conventional Commits message for the staged files.

### Version or environment

macOS

title: write-commit-message: empty message when a file is renamed
body:
### What happened

With a staged rename the commit message came back empty.

### What you expected

A message naming the rename.

### Version or environment

Windows

title: write-commit-message gives an empty message in a monorepo
body:
### What happened

In a monorepo the staged changes produce an empty commit message.

### What you expected

A scoped message.

### Version or environment

macOS
